ns2:section.sectionText: This course meets with BADM 332. This course is open to students pursuing the Graduate Minor or Concentration in International Business if application is accepted. This course is appropriate for 2nd year MBA students. All graduate and doctoral students interested from across campus will need to take part in an application process. You can find the application here: https://business.illinois.edu/subsistence/wp-content/uploads/sites/62/2015/09/Application-form-SPMDSM.pdf.
